reviews.title: Former 5-Star App is Now a Useless Shell
reviews.text: When I bought the Trinity+ in January, 2025, the app was FABULOUS!  I could perform each treatment along with the tutorial AND record it, complete with before/after pics.  On 4/9/26, ALL pics were deleted.  (They did give us time to download each individual pic, but there was no quick or easy way to download all pics and preserve the dates. Setting a date right before tax filing deadline was also not necessary & didn’t help.)  In June 2026, they removed treatments from the app AND the device pairing function so you could no longer track your treatments.  There is no way to even manually enter a treatment.  As for the website, the treatments are not tutorials (i.e., you can’t perform the treatment along with the video.) While they describe and demo the holds & glides, you have to pause the video for those where the sequence is repeated (they don’t repeat the sequence in the video they just tell you to do it.). WHO GUTS a GREAT APP to PROVIDE LESS FUNCTIONALITY?  There is NO REASON to download this app…save the space on and reduce the attack surface on your phone.

reviews.text:
Removing the ability to pair via Bluetooth and moving the guided routines to your website and elsewhere is a very bad business decision.  Some of the Bluetooth guided and paired routines contained frequency changes during the routine (or so the technician said) to enhance the treatment on different zones of the face.  How can that happen now that the device is un-paired?!!

Terrible, terrible business decision made without considering your client community who spent $100s of dollars for these devices.  

The people who made this decision destroyed your company. 

Why?!!

reviews.title: One month and already having issues
reviews.text:
This company’s behavior raises serious concerns about false advertising and deceptive business practices. The product’s app is essentially non‑functional, and my device only worked for about a month before the problems began. I filed a complaint with the Better Business Bureau, and the company responded by offering a refund “as a courtesy.” Throughout the entire process, they acted as if they were doing me a favor — yet when it came time to actually issue the refund, they offered me what the retailer pays, not what a customer pays. The amount they proposed was far below the actual retail price and nowhere near what the device and attachments cost.

To make matters worse, the app has been malfunctioning for months, and their development team still can’t figure out how to fix it. At this point, it feels like they need to hire actual experts — maybe even AI — because whatever they’re doing now clearly isn’t working. It’s embarrassing for a company selling a device that relies entirely on software to function.

Their practices are genuinely unacceptable. They market a device that uses electrical microcurrents on your face, yet when the app fails, they leave customers completely on their own, with no functioning app or site support to guide safe use. Between the false advertising, the defective product, the non‑functional app, the dismissive attitude, and the low‑ball refund attempt based on wholesale pricing, it’s hard not to see a pattern of disregard for customers.

And based on the number of similar complaints, I’m clearly not the only unhappy customer. Consumers deserve transparency, functional products, and fair treatment — none of which this company has provided.

reviews.title: Do Not Buy a NuFace Device for the App Functionality
reviews.text:
The NuFACE Trinity Pro+ touts the app as a major feature and selling point for their product. The app places treatment plans behind a paywall by forcing users to pair their devices to the app via Bluetooth. However, no matter what I do, I cannot get my NuFACE device to pair to the app, and it appears that scores of other users are facing the exact same issue. Furthermore, this has been a recurring problem for over two years. This app should be removed from the App Store due to the company’s decision not to correct this pervasive issue. It rises to the level of fraud at this point given the company’s reliance on Bluetooth pairing to access the core functionality of the device, and Apple is currently complicit in the fraud given that it knows, or should know, that NuFace is either incapable of providing a fully functional device/app experience or that it is deliberately choosing not to do so. I hope this app is removed from the App Store OR that the treatments are released.

EDIT: please refer to NuFace’s response to my review. It gives the exact steps offered on their website to troubleshoot, which I noted in my initial review that I had already attempted. With their response, NuFace has displayed how ineffective their “troubleshooting” is and exactly how little interest they have in fixing this rampant issue. Again, DO NOT BUY THEIR DEVICE if you intend to pair it with their app. They will do nothing but offer platitudes if you encounter any issues.
